name: oci-whiteout-plan
user: Container build engineer reviewing captured layer entries.
pain: Explain why a lower-layer file disappears without extracting an untrusted image.
smallest_capability: Compose normalized path manifests with ordinary and opaque OCI whiteouts, preserving same-layer additions and a deletion trace.
acceptance: Apply whiteouts only to lower-layer entries, regardless of member order.
Reject traversal, absolute paths and unsupported entry kinds.
Deterministic final paths and source-layer provenance.
demand: Inferred; image-spec whiteout clarification and dive archive/path-safety reports are relevant evidence, not requests for this tool.
discovery: Container-image diagnostics and OCI whiteout examples.
distinctness: No owned repository composes OCI whiteout manifests. portable-tree audits portability, not layer semantics.
limits: Not an OCI runtime, tar extractor, image registry client, permission or link resolver.
publication: Website publication in progress; remote CI not yet verified
